<section class="bs-cheatsheet" aria-label="Chapter summary cheat sheet">
  <header class="bs-cs-head"><div><div class="bs-cs-eyebrow">Quick reference</div><div class="bs-cs-title">Confidence Intervals</div></div></header>
  <div class="bs-cs-grid">
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">01 · The Shape</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Confidence Interval</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">estimate ± margin of error</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">The margin of error is a critical value times the standard error. 95% confidence means α = 0.05.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Example</span><span>90% CI: 78.1 ± 1.05 = [77.05, 79.15]</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">02 · Mean, σ Known</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Z-Interval</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">x̄ ± z<sub>α/2</sub> · σ / √n</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Use the normal critical value when the population standard deviation σ is known.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=CONFIDENCE.NORM(α, σ, n)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">03 · Mean, σ Unknown</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">t-Interval</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">x̄ ± t<sub>α/2</sub> · s / √n</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">When σ is estimated by s, use the t-distribution with n − 1 degrees of freedom. Its heavier tails give a wider interval.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=CONFIDENCE.T(α, s, n)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">04 · Proportion</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Proportion Interval</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">p̂ ± z<sub>α/2</sub> · √(p̂(1 − p̂) / n)</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">The sample proportion is approximately normal, so a z critical value is used.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=NORM.S.INV(1-α/2)*SQRT(p̂*(1-p̂)/n)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">05 · Critical Values</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">z and t</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">z: 1.645 (90%) · 1.96 (95%)</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">The multiplier that sets the confidence level. The t value is larger for small samples and close to z for large ones.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Excel</span><span>=NORM.S.INV(1-α/2) · =T.INV.2T(α, df)</span></div></article>
    <article class="bs-cs-card"><div class="bs-cs-label">06 · Planning</div><div class="bs-cs-card-title">Required Sample Size</div><div class="bs-cs-formula">n = (z<sub>α/2</sub> σ / E)²<br/>n = p̂(1 − p̂)(z<sub>α/2</sub> / E)²</div><p class="bs-cs-desc">Solve the margin of error E for n. Always round up, and use p̂ = 0.5 when the proportion is unknown.</p><div class="bs-excel"><span class="lbl">Example</span><span>E = 2, σ = 10, 95% → 96.04 → 97</span></div></article>
  </div>
  <div class="bs-cs-panels">
    <div class="bs-cs-panel"><div class="bs-cs-panel-title">Notation Guide</div><dl>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>x̄, p̂</dt><dd>Sample mean, proportion</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>σ, s</dt><dd>Population, sample std. dev.</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>n</dt><dd>Sample size</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>α</dt><dd>Significance level</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>z<sub>α/2</sub>, t<sub>α/2</sub></dt><dd>Critical values</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>df</dt><dd>Degrees of freedom, n − 1</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>E</dt><dd>Margin of error</dd></div>
    </dl></div>
    <div class="bs-cs-panel"><div class="bs-cs-panel-title">Key Facts</div><dl>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>95% critical z?</dt><dd>1.96</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>90% critical z?</dt><dd>1.645</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Higher confidence?</dt><dd>Wider interval</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>Larger sample?</dt><dd>Narrower interval</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>σ unknown?</dt><dd>Use the t-distribution</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>CONFIDENCE.T returns?</dt><dd>The margin of error</dd></div>
      <div class="bs-cs-row"><dt>What does 95% describe?</dt><dd>How often the method succeeds</dd></div>
    </dl></div>

</section>
